_comment: Hand-written recording of a Google Sheets cleaner-schedule read, shaped like a real spreadsheets.values().get() response for the offline replay of tests/integration/test_live_sheets.py. Columns A-F: A=cleaner checkbox, B=guest name, C=check-in (M/D/YYYY), D=check-out, E=time-in, F=time-out. The sentinel row uses the test-config pattern '--- end ---'. sheet_id mirrors a real numeric sheetId from spreadsheets.get().
